name: carrier
title: Aircraft carrier (mission 1 start)
usage: Mission 1 start reference (scripted fly-off from the bow catapults) and intro dressing. Pending review; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers or symbols anywhere: no hull number, name or pennant. Deck markings are plain straight lines only (landing-area edges, a dashed centre line, three wire lines, catapult track lines, elevator outlines, a parking line, a dashed foul line); no circles, crosses or glyph-like shapes.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No flags, ensigns, hull numbers or class markings; hull, island and deck plan are an original layout, not a copy of any real or game ship.

noFaces.note: No faces, figures or crew; no parked aircraft.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: Four covered point-defence domes on sponsons, as on any warship; no guns, missiles or aircraft weapons shown; nothing aimed, firing or damaged.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

design: Original flat-deck carrier: 9-degree angled landing area, starboard island aft of midships, two bow catapults with flush blast deflectors, three deck-edge elevators, four sponsons with covered domes. 560 studs long = 21.5 Kestrel lengths; deck 141 studs wide = 6.3 Kestrel spans.
